description: Stage 4 review resolver passes currently do not receive the plan Touch Set in input_payload or _build_resolver_prompt, so the resolver edits files outside the plan Touch Set and triggers fatal touch_set_violation halts after wasting full resolver turns.
goal: Resolve the effective plan Touch Set in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/resolver.py (_dispatch_review_resolver) and pass it as an optional 'touch_set' list in input_payload to the review-loop container. In apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/entrypoint/review_loop.py, read 'touch_set' from the findings payload, render the allowed Touch Set paths explicitly in _build_resolver_prompt forbidding edits outside that list and instructing the resolver to record a structured disposition naming the required external path instead of editing unlisted files when a finding requires an out-of-set file, and enforce a pre-commit guard in _commit_resolution that refuses committing out-of-set non-provenance edits before creating a commit. Keep 'touch_set' optional (defaulting to empty/unrestricted when omitted) so all existing tests and callers remain backward-compatible without editing other test modules. Do NOT modify flow/lazy_exports_review.py, flow/review/loop.py, or holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json, and keep every modified module within its existing line budget. Add hermetic unit tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/review/test_resolver_touch_set.py covering Touch Set propagation, prompt rendering, structured external-path disposition handling, and pre-commit refusal. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Showing the allowed Touch Set upfront in the resolver prompt and refusing out-of-set edits before commit eliminates avoidable Stage 4 touch_set_violation halts.
acceptance_criteria: `_dispatch_review_resolver` passes the effective plan Touch Set to the Stage 4 resolver container payload, and `_build_resolver_prompt` renders the allowed paths and instructs the resolver never to edit files outside them.
When a finding requires editing a file outside the Touch Set, the resolver records a structured disposition naming the required external path instead of committing an out-of-set edit.
Hermetic unit tests verify Touch Set propagation, prompt rendering, and pre-commit refusal; `uv run pytest` passes.

All changes remain within apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/resolver.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/entrypoint/review_loop.py, and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/review/test_resolver_touch_set.py (never modifying flow/lazy_exports_review.py, flow/review/loop.py, or holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json), `uv run task lint` passes, and code is self-explaining (no docstrings; only '# why:' comments).
